messages:
jin: proposing a new lightweight "fuzzy-compat" stage for onboarding. runs in ~2-3s per model: tokenizer sanity, short-seq generation, determinism probe, and a tiny perf delta. aim is to catch the obvious tokenization/serialization mismatches before heavyweight benching.
laura: love the idea. can we make it pluggable per-model-type? some LLMs need detokenize-roundtrip checks for legacy tokenizers.
sam: main runtime issue i see is false positives on determinism with beam/temperature defaults. we should fix a canonical eval config: temp=0, top_p=1, beam=1.
jin: yep — canonical config sounds good. also want to add a tiny golden-input set that's per-customer (opt-in) to detect regressions relevant to that customer.
priya: curious about thresholds. what's the acceptance criteria for fuzzy-compat vs fail-fast? e.g., tokenizer mismatch -> block? small ppv divergence -> warn?
ada: recommendation: hard fail for tokenization incompatibilities (different token counts for identical unicode), soft-fail for output deltas under a threshold. soft-fails create a quick triage ticket and mark model as "needs deep bench".
mike: operationally, add a vetting label so sales/customer-facing folks can see onboarding state: fuzzy-passed, fuzzy-softfail, fuzzy-blocked.
jin: agreed. also want to surface an easy re-run command in Console. devs should be able to re-run fuzzy checks with --seed and --sample-size.
laura: about the per-customer golden set: we must keep it encrypted and optional. if a customer opts-in we store hashes only and run masked comparisons.
sam: thinking about concurrency: fuzzy runs should be cheap but still rate-limited on the intake queue so we don't DDOS tiny clusters. default concurrency=8 per-runner.
priya: can we add a quick KB adversarial sample? tokenization mismatch isn't always deterministic; add a couple of corner-case unicode inputs.
jin: yes. propose these probes: ["emoji sequences", "ZWJ ligatures", "non-BMP chars", "trailing spaces", "mixed-NFKC/NFD"].
ada: quick config snippet for the canonical fuzz job:
```
mode: fuzzy-compat
seq_len: 32
samples: 16
seed: 42
decode: {temperature:0, top_p:1, deterministic: true}
checks: [token-count-stable, det-out-consistency, golden-hash-match]
```
mike: how do we integrate with rollback? if fuzzy detects tokenization block after a rollout, auto-rollback to previous model variant?
jin: automatic rollback only for hard blocks during pre-deploy. post-deploy monitors should alert and trigger manual rollback via ops playbook.
laura: another thought: store a lightweight fingerprint (vocab-hash + special-token-map) in the registry. onboarding checks can short-circuit if fingerprint matches known-good variants.
sam: fingerprinting reduces work. but we need a compatibility matrix for quantized variants vs fp32; fingerprint must include quant bits/format.
priya: and add a note to docs about edge cases: OOV fallback tokenization behaviors differ across tokenizers — require explicit token map in model manifest.
onboard-bot: fuzzy-compat run queued for model redwood/gptx-3-quant. started at 4767890150.
onboard-bot: fuzzy-compat finished for redwood/gptx-3-quant: status=soft-fail, token-count-stable=true, det-out-consistency=low-confidence, golden-hash-match=skipped.
ada: thanks. will triage det-out-consistency with runtime team — might be decode path mismatch in quantized runtime.
mike: please add a one-liner in the Console explaining soft-fail semantics so PM/customer support doesn't overreact.
jin: will draft the RFC follow-up doc with the stages (preflight, fuzzy-compat, mini-bench, full-bench) and acceptance matrix. pinging folks for review.
laura: i'll add the fingerprint schema to model-manifest.md and a migration tool to compute fingerprints for prod registry.
sam: i'll adjust runner defaults (concurrency, timeout) and add a metric for fuzzy-flake-rate.
priya: will prepare the adversarial sample list and coordinate opt-in golden-sets encryption flow with security.
mike: timeline? can we aim to ship fuzzy as opt-in alpha in 2 sprints?
jin: yes — alpha in 2 sprints. thanks all. will post the RFC link when ready.
